proposal.goal: Construct the second-coordinate heat-bath Markov kernel and prove exact invariance of its finite joint target.
proposal.source_anchor: Source-neutral kernel interface; inherited MCMC arXiv:2407.12751v1 §2.1.1 printed p.48 / PDF p.54 and Discrete arXiv:2307.13826v4 §1.3 PDF p.5 conditional-update context.
proposal.theorem_delta: Define heatBathSnd, infer Markovness, expose the pointwise Dirac-product law, and prove heatBathSnd_invariant via the existing ASTIS disintegration identity. Exercise finite powers using existing invariant_pow in Tests.HeatBath.
proposal.truth_boundary: Finite μ including zero; arbitrary measurable α and nonempty Standard-Borel β. No reversibility, scan mixtures, mixing, conditional support on null fibers, concrete Gibbs support/positivity, or SDE claim.

proof_route: Compose deterministic first projection with the product of identity and condDistrib snd fst μ.
Use existing Markov instances for condDistrib, deterministic projection, product and composition.
Expose pointwise law using comp_deterministic_eq_comap, comap_apply, prod_apply and id_apply.
Transport action on μ by Measure.comp_assoc and deterministic_comp_eq_map to the action on μ.map fst.
Rewrite that action as a measure composition-product and invoke ConditionalResampling.fst_compProd_condDistrib_snd_eq_self.
Compile a finite-power consumer using KernelInvariance.invariant_pow and explicit zero-measure cases.

mathematical_result: The explicitly constructed Markov kernel heatBathSnd μ retains the first coordinate through a Dirac factor and resamples the second via the selected condDistrib version. Its action preserves every finite joint measure μ, including zero, by the existing ASTIS disintegration identity. Tests instantiate the existing invariant_pow interface for all n.
